note: Facts plus a look. The fact sheet prints one radius and a width for each ring, not edges: a band is the printed radius plus or minus half the printed width (the middle of a printed range); the inner group runs from ring 6 to ring 4 and the middle group from alpha to lambda, drawn as the donor draws them (the gaps between those rings are not drawn). A ring narrower than the 2048-pixel ring texture can show (about 100 km a pixel here) is drawn 400 km wide, centred on its printed radius (drawnWidthKm); the printed values are kept on the band. Colours and opacities are Planetary Explorer's five Uranus ring bands (donor src/entities/uranus.ts), matched to the fact sheet's rings by order. Brightness is a look, not a measurement.
